description: Side-sliding navigation panel with animated hamburger morph, staggered menu reveals, and a cinematic full-screen backdrop

props.name: panelWidth
props.description: Width of the sliding menu panel.

props.name: openDuration
props.description: Duration of the sidebar opening and closing slide.

props.name: linksStagger
props.description: Stagger between the main navigation links as they animate in.

props.name: socialsStagger
props.description: Stagger between the social links as they animate in.

name: slide-text-reveal
title: Slide Text Reveal
description: Characters slide in from the right with staggered fade animation on scroll

name: spider-particles
title: Spider Particles
description: Canvas particle network background with connecting lines and mouse-driven repulsion.

name: split-canvas
title: Split Canvas
description: Scroll-synced canvas transition that reveals images through sliced pixel-grid shutters

changelog.summary: Added prefers-reduced-motion support: the pixel-grid shutter transition becomes a plain crossfade between images

name: spotlight-button
title: Spotlight Button
description: Animated orbiting halo button with a glowing border and hover spotlight.

props.name: haloColor
props.description: Main color of the orbiting halo.

props.name: haloCoreColor
props.description: Bright core color on hover and keyboard focus.

props.name: spotlightIntensity
props.description: Strength of the border spotlight and glow.

props.name: orbitDuration
props.description: Seconds for one full orbit.

props.name: settleDuration
props.description: Hover and focus transition duration in seconds.

props.name: haloWidth
props.description: Width of each halo gradient segment as a percentage of the sweep.

props.name: size
props.description: Button size: small, medium, or large.

name: spotlight-text
title: Spotlight Text
description: Mouse-tracked spotlight that reveals bright text through a radial gradient mask over dimmed text. Disabled on mobile.

changelog.summary: Added reduced-motion support for accessible lower-motion spotlight tracking.

name: square-translate
title: Square Translate
description: Scroll-driven list where a rotating square marker tracks progress and nudges nearby rows

changelog.summary: Added prefers-reduced-motion support: only the item currently aligned with the cube shifts (other items stay at their initial position instead of rippling), and the shift moves only the row's text, not its border

name: stack-loader
title: Stack Loader
description: Stack-to-spread image intro loader with GSAP SplitText word animations and staggered image choreography

name: stack-spread
title: Stack Spread
description: A clustered stack of images that spreads into a full-bleed composition on scroll while centre text fades in behind it

props.name: scrollLength
props.description: Total scroll distance the spread plays out over, in vh. Sets the section height.

props.name: clusterRotation
props.description: Fan the clustered stack with each card's own angle, or start every card flat.

props.name: stackScale
props.description: Scale of the cards while clustered, before they spread out to full size.

props.name: cardRadius
props.description: Corner radius on each card, in px (desktop only - tablet/mobile keep their responsive radius).

props.name: bgColor
props.description: Background color of the section behind the cards.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Color of the centre headline and subtitle.

props.name: textFadeStart
props.description: Scroll progress (0-1) where the centre text starts fading in.

name: stacking-cards
title: Stacking Cards
description: Full-screen card sequence that stacks, tilts, and reveals the next scene on scroll

name: sticky-content-wrapper
title: Sticky Content Wrapper
description: Split-screen sticky scroll with content on one side and images on the other, revealing on scroll

name: strip-slider
title: Strip Slider
description: WebGL image slider that splits each slide into vertical strips, transitioning with a staggered wave distortion using Three.ts shader materials and GSAP

name: svg-brush-transition

changelog.summary: Added reduced-motion route fallback with short opacity fades.

title: SVG Brush Transition
description: Brush-stroke navigation transition that draws a large SVG path across the viewport

name: svg-path
title: Marquee on SVG Path
description: Animate any content along a custom SVG path. Supports scroll velocity, drag interaction, hover slowdown, and responsive scaling.

changelog.summary: Added reduced-motion support and made the marquee suspend its per-frame work while offscreen or in a hidden tab.

name: svg-pixel-reveal
title: SVG Pixel Reveal
description: Scroll-driven image that transitions from pixelated to crisp using an SVG filter and GSAP ScrollTrigger

name: sweep-lift-transition
title: Sweep Lift Transition
description: The outgoing page lifts and fades into the background while the incoming page sweeps up from the bottom via a clip-path reveal.

props.name: bgColor
props.description: Background color behind the transitioning pages.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration used by both the outgoing lift and incoming sweep reveal.

name: testimonial-swiper
title: Testimonial Swiper
description: Editorial testimonial slider with split-text quote transitions and directional controls

changelog.summary: Reworked the props API (testimonials, bgColor, accentColor, autoplay, navigation, imageSize), added reduced-motion support, and fixed default color and demo layout issues.

name: text-cloning
title: Text Cloning
description: Canvas 2D effect that renders 9 depth-layered clones of any text string, offset by mouse parallax to create a 3D depth illusion. Includes a live text input and a subtle star-field background.

changelog.summary: Added reduced-motion support and reworked the props API (cloneCount, offset, colors, textSize) while keeping live text editing on the demo page.

name: text-convergence
title: Text Convergence
description: Horizontal scroll-driven text marquee where characters fly in from random positions and converge into place as you scroll

changelog.summary: Added prefers-reduced-motion support: per-character fly-in yPercent/rotation range is reduced to 25% strength; the main horizontal scroll is unaffected

name: text-fill-animation
title: Text Fill Animation
description: Scroll-synced text color fill animation with customizable color sweep effect

name: text-hover
title: Text Hover
description: Expandable text list with hover/click to reveal descriptions and animated corner brackets

changelog.summary: Added reduced-motion support and reworked the props API (textColor, hoverColor, duration), fixing the default hover color and centering the hover frame.

name: text-stream
title: Text Stream
description: Infinite vertical text marquee that accelerates and reverses direction based on scroll velocity, with a hard-edge mask and static prefix label

changelog.summary: Reworked the props API (speed, stagger, runOnScroll, independent autoplay toggle), added reduced-motion support, and restored default color scheme.

name: timeline
title: Timeline
description: Horizontal scroll timeline with Lenis smoothing, GSAP milestone reveals, and reduced-motion support.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Text color used for the timeline title, dates, and milestone descriptions.

props.name: mutedTextColor
props.description: Secondary text color for descriptions and the period label.

props.name: activeColor
props.description: Accent color shared by the active timeline line, dots, and milestone stems.

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: Background color of the timeline section.

props.name: duration
props.description: Reveal animation and Lenis smoothing duration in seconds.

changelog.summary: Initial timeline registry release with configurable colors, Lenis scroll tuning, and reduced-motion support.

name: typing-text
title: Typing Text
description: Vault-themed typewriter text with sequential, cascade, looping, and shape-shifting cursor variants.

props.name: variant
props.description: Typing sequence variant.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Typed text color.

props.name: cursorColor
props.description: Cursor color.

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: Background color.

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Text size in vw units.

props.name: fontWeight
props.description: Font weight.

props.name: lineHeight
props.description: Line height.

props.name: letterSpacing

props.name: textAlign
props.description: Text alignment.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Maximum text block width in vw units.

props.name: charactersPerSecond
props.description: Typing speed.

props.name: animationDuration
props.description: Multiplier applied to each line typing duration.

props.name: lineDelay
props.description: Delay between line starts.

props.name: holdDuration
props.description: Hold time before loop reset.

props.name: typingDirection
props.description: Direction the text types from.

props.name: blur
props.description: Starting blur in pixels.

props.name: rotate
props.description: Starting X rotation in degrees.

props.name: scale
props.description: Starting scale before the line settles.

props.name: perspective
props.description: Perspective depth for rotated typing.

props.name: cursorStyle
props.description: Cursor visual style.

props.name: cursorWidth
props.description: Cursor thickness in pixels.

props.name: showCursor
props.description: Shows the animated cursor.

name: unfold-navbar
title: Unfold Navbar
description: A compact side navigation that unfolds vertically and horizontally, with staggered links and a feature image.

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: Navbar surface color.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Main links and menu icon color.

props.name: mutedColor
props.description: Numbers, secondary links, captions, and dimmed links color.

props.name: animationSpeed
props.description: Opening and closing speed multiplier. Higher values animate faster.

props.name: charStagger
props.description: Delay between characters on link hover, in seconds.

props.name: showLinkUnderline
props.description: Show the animated underline on link hover.

props.name: showNumbers
props.description: Show numbers beside primary links.

props.name: dimInactiveLinks
props.description: Dim other primary links while hovering a row.

props.name: showFeature
props.description: Show the feature image and caption.

name: variable-text-proximity
title: Variable Hover
description: Cursor-driven variable-font text where nearby letters gain weight and optical size

props.name: radius
props.description: Pointer influence radius.

props.name: falloff
props.description: How quickly the font variation fades with distance.

props.name: baseWeight
props.description: Font weight away from the pointer.

props.name: hoverWeight
props.description: Font weight nearest the pointer.

props.name: baseOpticalSize
props.description: Optical size away from the pointer.

props.name: hoverOpticalSize
props.description: Optical size nearest the pointer.

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: Demo background color.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Text color.

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Paragraph font size in pixels.

props.name: lineHeight
props.description: Paragraph line height.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Maximum paragraph width in pixels.

props.name: minWidth
props.description: Minimum paragraph width in pixels.

props.name: italic
props.description: Slant nearby letters toward italic on pointer proximity.

name: video-player
title: Custom Video Player
description: Minimal cinematic video player with timed controls, scrubbing, and mute state

changelog.summary: Replaced the rAF progress loop with native timeupdate events.

name: webgl-slider
title: WebGL Slider
description: Scroll-driven WebGL image slider with fold distortion, hover interaction, and Lenis + GSAP snap behavior.

name: zoom-slider

changelog.summary: Added reduced-motion support and customizable slider content.

title: Zoom Slider
description: Infinitely looping horizontal image carousel where the active card expands using a quadratic easing curve as it enters from the right. Supports scroll, drag, and touch. Hover reveals GSAP SplitText line animations above each card.
